title: Three pages say the Map's dualism "suggests" or "posits" a "sea of conscious entities" any of which could bind to a physical system, and `apex/what-it-might-be-like-to-be-an-ai` L166 says this "is what the tenet already licenses — … argued in the tenets". `tenets/tenets.md` contains no such posit, and `topics/evolution-under-dualism` L105 says a dualist "need not assume" coupling, the Map preferring it only "provisionally"
